datasets.name: kpi_totals
datasets.query: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN u.usage_unit='DBU' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE)*COALESCE(CAST(p.pricing.effective_list.default AS DOUBLE),0)*fx.usd_to_gbp ELSE 0 END),2) AS total_cost_gbp, ROUND((SELECT SUM(GREATEST(y_forecast,0)) FROM ai_forecast(TABLE(SELECT usage_date AS ds, SUM(CASE WHEN u2.usage_unit='DBU' THEN CAST(u2.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE)*COALESCE(CAST(p2.pricing.effective_list.default AS DOUBLE),0)*fx2.usd_to_gbp ELSE 0 END) AS y FROM system.billing.usage u2 LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices p2 ON u2.sku_name=p2.sku_name AND u2.usage_start_time>=p2.price_start_time AND (p2.price_end_time IS NULL OR u2.usage_start_time<p2.price_end_time) LEFT JOIN (SELECT rate_date,usd_to_gbp,COALESCE(LEAD(rate_date) OVER (ORDER BY rate_date),DATE_ADD(rate_date,365)) AS next_rate_date FROM bronze_dev.raw_reference.fx_rates_usd_gbp) fx2 ON u2.usage_date>=fx2.rate_date AND u2.usage_date<fx2.next_rate_date WHERE u2.record_type='ORIGINAL' AND u2.usage_unit='DBU' GROUP BY usage_date ORDER BY usage_date), horizon=>'2026-06-30',time_col=>'ds',value_col=>'y')),2) AS forecasted_cost_gbp, CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(MIN(u.usage_date), 'dd MMM yyyy'), ' – ', DATE_FORMAT(MAX(u.usage_date), 'dd MMM yyyy')) AS coverage_period FROM system.billing.usage u LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices p ON u.sku_name=p.sku_name AND u.usage_start_time>=p.price_start_time AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time<p.price_end_time) LEFT JOIN (SELECT rate_date,usd_to_gbp,COALESCE(LEAD(rate_date) OVER (ORDER BY rate_date),DATE_ADD(rate_date,365)) AS next_rate_date FROM bronze_dev.raw_reference.fx_rates_usd_gbp) fx ON u.usage_date>=fx.rate_date AND u.usage_date<fx.next_rate_date WHERE u.record_type='ORIGINAL'

datasets.name: avg_by_granularity
datasets.query: WITH base AS (SELECT u.usage_date, SUM(CASE WHEN u.usage_unit='DBU' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE)*COALESCE(CAST(p.pricing.effective_list.default AS DOUBLE),0)*fx.usd_to_gbp ELSE 0 END) AS day_cost FROM system.billing.usage u LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices p ON u.sku_name=p.sku_name AND u.usage_start_time>=p.price_start_time AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time<p.price_end_time) LEFT JOIN (SELECT rate_date,usd_to_gbp,COALESCE(LEAD(rate_date) OVER (ORDER BY rate_date),DATE_ADD(rate_date,365)) AS next_rate_date FROM bronze_dev.raw_reference.fx_rates_usd_gbp) fx ON u.usage_date>=fx.rate_date AND u.usage_date<fx.next_rate_date WHERE u.record_type='ORIGINAL' GROUP BY u.usage_date) SELECT 'Daily' AS granularity, ROUND(AVG(day_cost),2) AS avg_cost_gbp FROM base UNION ALL SELECT 'Weekly', ROUND(AVG(week_cost),2) FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('WEEK',usage_date) AS wk, SUM(day_cost) AS week_cost FROM base GROUP BY 1) UNION ALL SELECT 'Monthly', ROUND(AVG(month_cost),2) FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH',usage_date) AS mo, SUM(day_cost) AS month_cost FROM base GROUP BY 1)

datasets.name: usage_over_time
datasets.query: SELECT ds, ROUND(cost_gbp,4) AS cost_gbp, series_type FROM (SELECT usage_date AS ds, SUM(CASE WHEN u.usage_unit='DBU' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE)*COALESCE(CAST(p.pricing.effective_list.default AS DOUBLE),0)*fx.usd_to_gbp ELSE 0 END) AS cost_gbp, 'Actual' AS series_type FROM system.billing.usage u LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices p ON u.sku_name=p.sku_name AND u.usage_start_time>=p.price_start_time AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time<p.price_end_time) LEFT JOIN (SELECT rate_date,usd_to_gbp,COALESCE(LEAD(rate_date) OVER (ORDER BY rate_date),DATE_ADD(rate_date,365)) AS next_rate_date FROM bronze_dev.raw_reference.fx_rates_usd_gbp) fx ON u.usage_date>=fx.rate_date AND u.usage_date<fx.next_rate_date WHERE u.record_type='ORIGINAL' GROUP BY usage_date UNION ALL SELECT ds, GREATEST(y_forecast,0) AS cost_gbp, 'Forecast' AS series_type FROM ai_forecast(TABLE(SELECT usage_date AS ds, SUM(CASE WHEN u.usage_unit='DBU' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE)*COALESCE(CAST(p.pricing.effective_list.default AS DOUBLE),0)*fx.usd_to_gbp ELSE 0 END) AS y FROM system.billing.usage u LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices p ON u.sku_name=p.sku_name AND u.usage_start_time>=p.price_start_time AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time<p.price_end_time) LEFT JOIN (SELECT rate_date,usd_to_gbp,COALESCE(LEAD(rate_date) OVER (ORDER BY rate_date),DATE_ADD(rate_date,365)) AS next_rate_date FROM bronze_dev.raw_reference.fx_rates_usd_gbp) fx ON u.usage_date>=fx.rate_date AND u.usage_date<fx.next_rate_date WHERE u.record_type='ORIGINAL' AND u.usage_unit='DBU' GROUP BY usage_date ORDER BY usage_date), horizon=>'2026-06-30',time_col=>'ds',value_col=>'y')) ORDER BY ds

datasets.name: cost_by_product
datasets.query: SELECT billing_origin_product, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN u.usage_unit='DBU' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE)*COALESCE(CAST(p.pricing.effective_list.default AS DOUBLE),0)*fx.usd_to_gbp ELSE 0 END),2) AS cost_gbp FROM system.billing.usage u LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices p ON u.sku_name=p.sku_name AND u.usage_start_time>=p.price_start_time AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time<p.price_end_time) LEFT JOIN (SELECT rate_date,usd_to_gbp,COALESCE(LEAD(rate_date) OVER (ORDER BY rate_date),DATE_ADD(rate_date,365)) AS next_rate_date FROM bronze_dev.raw_reference.fx_rates_usd_gbp) fx ON u.usage_date>=fx.rate_date AND u.usage_date<fx.next_rate_date WHERE u.record_type='ORIGINAL' GROUP BY billing_origin_product HAVING cost_gbp > 0 ORDER BY cost_gbp DESC

datasets.name: cost_by_product_over_time
datasets.query: SELECT usage_date, billing_origin_product, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN u.usage_unit='DBU' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE)*COALESCE(CAST(p.pricing.effective_list.default AS DOUBLE),0)*fx.usd_to_gbp ELSE 0 END),4) AS cost_gbp FROM system.billing.usage u LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices p ON u.sku_name=p.sku_name AND u.usage_start_time>=p.price_start_time AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time<p.price_end_time) LEFT JOIN (SELECT rate_date,usd_to_gbp,COALESCE(LEAD(rate_date) OVER (ORDER BY rate_date),DATE_ADD(rate_date,365)) AS next_rate_date FROM bronze_dev.raw_reference.fx_rates_usd_gbp) fx ON u.usage_date>=fx.rate_date AND u.usage_date<fx.next_rate_date WHERE u.record_type='ORIGINAL' GROUP BY usage_date, billing_origin_product ORDER BY usage_date
